headline: Washington's title window meets Arizona State's desperation in Tempe
subhead: The fourth-ranked Huskies visit 0-2 Arizona State seeking to maintain momentum while the Sun Devils face an early season crossroads.

xFactor.why: Arizona State's pass rush must create early pressure to disrupt Washington's rhythm and force mistakes in a win-or-bust scenario.

keyMatchup: Washington's offensive line cohesion against an Arizona State front seven that has been gassed and vulnerable after two straight losses.
body: Washington arrives in Tempe having scraped past Miami in a game that revealed both resilience and sloppiness. The Huskies' win-at-all-costs mentality kept them unbeaten, but their secondary looked occasionally exposed when pressured—something Arizona State's desperate pass rush will absolutely test. A team ranked fourth nationally cannot afford to play down to an 0-2 opponent, and Arizona State will use that pressure as its only realistic path forward.

Arizona State's back-to-back defeats have left the Sun Devils searching for identity and momentum with no margin for error. Their close loss to LSU suggests competitive football, but losing at home to Washington would force drastic mid-season recalibration. For Washington, winning on the road against a reeling Pac-12 rival would cement their status as a legitimate playoff contender rather than simply a beneficiary of early schedule positioning.
